verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs claim continuous monitoring and evidence collection through integrations with the cloud stack ([sprinto-docs-25], [sprinto-docs-39], [sprinto-docs-21]). Specific connectors are documented, such as JumpCloud and the FreeAgent offboarding checks, along with integration monitoring and webhook ingestion. However, these are mostly high-level marketing statements, and the AI gap-analysis feature still covers uploaded screenshots, which implies manual evidence remains part of the workflow. Missing for 10: documented collection schedule/cadence, detail on timestamped machine-gathered artifacts, evidence that screenshot/CSV uploads are actually replaced, independent or hands-on corroboration.
